<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Fascinated by Society](/Feats.aspx?ID=5299) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 25

</column>

---

Just as some humanoids find themselves driven to study nature, you are obsessed with the artificial constructs of society and can't get enough. You are trained in [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47). If you would automatically become trained in Society, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

 As a newcomer, sometimes your understanding is a bit off target. When you fail, but don't critically fail, a Society check to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=2367) or [Decipher Writing](/Actions.aspx?ID=2363), you learn the correct information (as you would on a success) and erroneous information (as you would on a critical failure). You don't have any way to differentiate which is which.

<title level="2">Fascinated by Society leads to...</title>
[Urban Jungle](/Feats.aspx?ID=5312)
